answer: Cross-identity similarity gating resists sybils: every answer is shingled and compared by Jaccard overlap against other identities' submissions, and near-duplicates are flagged before reward. A farm reusing one template across many keys lights up as a relic cluster of near-identical shingles — honest work scatters across the lexical lagoon, but a ring pools at the zenith of overlap. The floor is identity-blind, catching reuse when other signals are clean; a farm must author K distinct answers, raising cost linearly. Precondition: threshold passes honest paraphrase, fails mechanical reuse.
